title: AI search optimization
summary: Make the business easy for answer engines to understand and cite. Included in the $1,500 monthly plan. Not a promise of a ChatGPT mention.
metaTitle: AI Search Optimization | Nick Perry Digital
metaDescription: AI search optimization for local businesses on the Western Slope. Included in the $1,500 plan. No guaranteed chatbot placement.
body:
People are starting to ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI answers for a plumber, a dentist, or a shop in a specific town. Those tools lean on the same public record as classic search: your site, your Google listing, reviews, and directories. They also like pages that answer a question in plain language.

AI search optimization is the extra work in the $1,500 plan. It includes an AI visibility check, content shaped for answers, monitoring, and local outreach. I do not guarantee that any assistant will recommend you. Anyone who does is selling a result they do not control.
gets: A check of how your name, services, and towns are described in public
Pages and listing text that answer real customer questions
Alignment between the site, the Google profile, and major directories
Monitoring for whether AI tools mention you, with the limits of that check stated
Local link and press outreach, with placement fees billed by the publisher
A monthly note on what changed

steps.title: See the record
steps.text: I look at what an assistant can actually find: the site, the listing, reviews, and conflicting directory data.

steps.title: Make it quotable
steps.text: We tighten service descriptions and FAQs so a tool can repeat them without inventing details.

steps.title: Watch and adjust
steps.text: Each month I note mentions I can verify and the gaps that are still blocking a clear recommendation.

faqs.a: It is the work of making your public information clear enough that answer engines can describe you correctly. It sits on top of ordinary SEO and a healthy Google listing.

faqs.q: Can you get my business into ChatGPT?
faqs.a: I can improve the sources those tools tend to use. I cannot force a mention. The $1,500 plan includes the work. It does not include a guaranteed placement.

faqs.q: How is this different from SEO?
faqs.a: SEO is still the base: a clear site, a real listing, and consistent facts. AI search work adds answer-style content, a visibility check, and outreach. The $850 plan is the base. The $1,500 plan adds this layer.

faqs.q: Does this matter for a small town?
faqs.a: Yes, if customers in that town are asking assistants for recommendations. The same cleanup that helps Google also helps those tools. A thin page with a city name stuffed into it does not.
